project: Wuxia Life P7.2 Server Authoritative Active Planning
description: Unify P7 active life planning under the server-authoritative session API. Granular stories: one contract slice, one headless method, one service endpoint slice, one client wiring slice, or one test/doc artifact per iteration. API mode becomes canonical; local mode is dev fallback only.

userStories.title: Inventory Local Active Planning Flow
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only inventory of the local P7 active-planning path so that P7.2 wiring targets the proven reference flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Document getNextEvent branch when selectEvent returns null
Document getAvailableActiveActions and buildActiveActionChoices usage
Document executeActiveAction, summary display, disturbance display, and return-to-planning ack
List file paths for useNewGameEngine, GameEngineIntegration, ActivePlanningService
Do not modify business code

userStories.title: Inventory API Session Gap
